name: Get Ready With Me
summary: A creator talks to a close phone camera while she or he does make-up or picks an outfit, with soft light, a mirror, jump cuts and a line of captions. The form grew from YouTube make-up tutorials of the 2000s.

philosophy.core_thesis: Share a real routine in real time: the talk matters more than the result.
design_principles: Frame the face and shoulders at 55% to 70% of the frame height, with eyes at 38% from the top.
Light with a ring light or a window at 5600 K to 6500 K.
Use jump cuts at 1 cut every 2 s to 5 s; remove all pauses.
Set a hook line in the first 1.5 s, for example the event or the place.
Caption the speech in 40 px words, 2 lines at most, at 65% of the frame height.
Show product names as 28 px text tags with a 12 px radius, placed near the product.
Use a warm, soft grade: lift shadows by 10% and keep skin tones at 2 to 3 stops of exposure.
anti_patterns: Wide shots of an empty room
Heavy filters that change the skin

layout.grid_mechanics: A single vertical frame with a face-and-mirror composition; a caption zone at 62% to 76% of the height; product tags on the right third.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the frame is soft background; text takes under 10%.
layout.alignment_rules: Face centred; captions centred; tags align to the right edge with a 32 px margin.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded video corners of 24 px in the post view; pill tags of 12 px radius; 1:1 product thumbnails.

font_pairings.note: A friendly sans in medium and bold weights.
A rounded sans that matches the soft mood.

hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for the hook line and regular (400) for captions.
Set the hook at 56 px and captions at 40 px.
Set text in white with a 4% black shadow, or in dark text on a cream pill.
Limit a caption to 6 words per cut.

color.palette_structure: Warm neutrals with one soft blush, on a cream and beige base.
color.contrast_rules: Espresso on cream gives 12:1; white caption text needs a 40% dark pill below it.
color.surface_treatment: Soft, matte, warm; skin tones lead.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft window light from the left at 45°; a 10% shadow lift; no hard shadows.

materiality.surface_simulation: A bathroom mirror and a bedroom: matte skin, glass and cotton.
materiality.border_rules: No borders; a 1 px cream ring on product tags.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A soft blur of 12 px on the background when the mirror is out of focus.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline 24 px icons for bookmark, share and audio.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Small hand-drawn sparkle marks and a product tag.

motion.transition_physics: Jump cuts at 2 s to 5 s; outfit changes cut on a hand wave; a caption fades in over 200 ms.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on a product tag opens a card that scales from 95% to 100% in 200 ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels at ease, as if a friend talks while she or he gets ready.

avoid_when: The audience needs hard technical facts.
The scene has no personal host.

modifiers.how: Use a tripod, a second camera angle and a title card of 1.5 s.
Add speed ramps and beat cuts between the outfit changes.
Turn each step into a still slide with a 1 line caption.

pack.why: A thin outline family that suits a soft, personal feed.

ground.why: The ground is a soft warm wash that echoes window light in a bedroom.

tailwind.classes: rounded-full bg-[#C9776F] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#FBF3EA]
